relationships.subject: Salmon calcitonin
relationships.evidence_quote: After treatment for 3 mo, the serum matrix metalloproteinase-3 (MMP-3) and matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) levels in study group were lower than those in control group (p<0.05).

relationships.subject: Salmon calcitonin
relationships.evidence_quote: The pain degree in study group was alleviated after treatment for 3 mo compared with the control group (p<0.05).

key_findings: Salmon calcitonin lowered serum MMP-3 and MMP-9 and pain after vertebroplasty
